title: EpicSpawner
description: Manage, buy and sell spawners with an advanced system of economy, rarity, chunk limits and anti-lag protection. EpicSpawner delivers a complete, optimized and fully configurable experience.
body:
# ⚡ EpicSpawner

### The ultimate spawner system for your server

EpicSpawner is not just a spawner plugin.
It is a complete solution designed to provide control, economy, optimization and a more advanced Minecraft experience.

With EpicSpawner you can manage, buy, sell and protect spawners in a simple, powerful and fully configurable way.

Designed for Survival, Skyblock, Prison and Economy servers.

Every spawner has value.
Every star counts.
Every decision matters.

---

## ✨ Main Features

🛒 Buy and sell spawner system
⭐ Star-based rarity and value system
⛏ Spawners can only be broken with Silk Touch
🖥 Easy and intuitive GUI menu
📊 Custom descriptions for each spawner
⚡ Optimized anti-lag system
📦 Configurable spawner limits per chunk
✨ Spawner holograms
🔒 Enable or disable spawners from the GUI
💰 Full economy integration
🌍 Multi-language support per player
🔧 Fully configurable

---

## ⚙ Commands

`/epicspawner`

Main plugin command.

Aliases:

`/es`
`/spawner`
`/spawners`

Subcommands:

`shop` → Open the spawner shop
`sell` → Sell spawners
`language` → Change language
`reload` → Reload configuration
`give` → Give spawners
`setlimit` → Configure limits
`toggle` → Enable or disable spawners
`info` → View information

---

## 🔑 Permissions

`epicspawner.use` → Basic plugin usage
`epicspawner.shop` → Access the shop
`epicspawner.sell` → Allows selling
`epicspawner.language` → Change language
`epicspawner.admin` → Administrative access
`epicspawner.reload` → Reload the plugin
`epicspawner.give` → Give spawners
`epicspawner.setlimit` → Change limits
`epicspawner.toggle` → Enable/disable spawners
`epicspawner.bypass.limit` → Ignore limits
`epicspawner.bypass.cooldown` → Ignore cooldowns

---

## 📦 Dependencies

### Required:

• Vault

Allows integration with economy systems.

---

### Optional:

• PlaceholderAPI

Compatible with custom placeholders.

Examples:

`%epicspawner_value%`
`%epicspawner_stars%`
`%epicspawner_status%`
`%epicspawner_stack%`

---

## 🖥 Compatibility

✔ Paper
✔ Spigot

✔ Compatible from **1.15+ to 1.21+**

---

## 🌍 Languages

Default:

🇪🇸 Spanish

Also includes:

🇺🇸 English

Each player can change their language individually.

---

## 🚀 Installation

1. Install Vault
2. (Optional) Install PlaceholderAPI
3. Place EpicSpawner in `/plugins`
4. Restart your server
5. Configure it as you like
6. Enjoy

---
